review:
Big Bass Mission Fishin' gives you a choice of bonus. Three or more fish scatters let you pick between free spins or a Stack the Cash bonus, so you can choose between the familiar collect-and-retrigger round and a respin feature.

In the free spins, modifiers such as more wilds and extra spins are in play, and there are four levels with the cash multiplier rising up to 10x. Choosing Stack the Cash instead brings robo-crabs and money fish coins onto the reels, with respins awarded each time a fish coin lands and all values collected when the respins run out. Unusually for the series, the speedboat symbol pays for just two of a kind. The RTP is 96.5%. Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a max win on the game page.
